summary: Ported audit-06's one-entry leaf memo as the gated engine variant approaches/lifetime-objective/fast-engine-memo (memo-leaf.hpp; MemoSearch generated from fast-search.hpp with a 15-line diff guard and a check that the memo call sits directly below ++work_; -ffp-contract=off pinned). Gates on real probe seeds: leaf bits 0/4,260 (d4s5) and 0/2,500 (d4s7) mismatches in the search's feeding order; search parity 0 mismatches over 160 (d4s5) and 50 (d4s7) moves, 117.7M/119.6M leaf calls, memo hit rates 61.7%/68.5%; determinism 0 mismatches at 1 vs 4 threads; interleaved timing plain/memo 1.58x (d4s5, 12 real roots x 3 reps) and 1.63x (d4s7, 6 roots x 2 reps), indicative under a 30-thread load. The prototype and the measurement method came from the audit subagent (CT-20260822T073043Z-f8dcf45a); the placement requirement from Kimi K3's review (CT-20260822T073043Z-6aa6d992).
validationPerformed: build.sh diff guard (15 lines) and ++work_ placement check
limitations: Timing ratios are indicative (host at load ~30); an idle-host, three-repeat measurement is owed before any throughput claim.

Not yet used by any cohort runner: the in-flight experiments keep their gated binaries; adopting the memo in evaluate.cpp/run.cpp is a one-line substitution in their build scripts plus a re-run of their gates.
